boundedParentReturn.policy: Terrain-only strip split on original root DEM triangles, exact root join at boundary and unchanged interior. No original model geometry edits; whole retained scene requires fresh checks.

numericCrackCaps.policy: Minimal Float32 hulls over exact gaps, constant floor at the minimum height of authenticated adjacent terrain over the hull boundary, rounded downward by one Float32 ULP; existing terrain facets retained, caps may extend beneath existing facets; any height increase over existing facets is bounded by the existing .004m criterion. Every old terrain facet remains; lower overlapping cap surfaces cannot replace the existing highest surface. Terrain correction only.

parentWaterMask.policy: Raw parent water/land classification preserved at every refinement node.

source.policy: Exact current rendered native surface retained outside explicit bounded original inset; all current source faces accounted for. Existing terrain grid/water/vegetation and original building geometry unchanged. Private proposal; all physical/current-neighbour/browser/publication checks remain mandatory.

finalBoundarySnap.policy: All final native boundary vertices join the rendered root parent after clipping and hole filling.

numericalCoverageGap.qualification: Metadata declaration only: native float32 terrain geometry is unchanged. Existing full source contact, foundation and runtime/rendered sampler checks remain mandatory.

parentHoleFill.policy: Current parent terrain sampled only where recovered native TIN is absent and outside the protected source-model projection.

source.policy: Exact current rendered native surface retained outside explicit bounded original inset; all current source faces accounted for. Existing terrain grid/water/vegetation and original building geometry unchanged. Private proposal; all physical/current-neighbour/browser/publication checks remain mandatory.

protectedParentProjection.policy: Current rendered parent terrain is retained only beneath the unresolved neighbouring source form; no building geometry or elevation changes.
